summary: Focused frontend test of the Sticker Book Home button resize. The icon box on /sticker-book (sticker-home-btn) measures 40x40 at 390px, 48x48 at 768px and 64x64 at 1920px. This matches the GameHeader back-button shield box on /rhythm-game, /loop-studio and /boom-garden exactly at all three widths. Clicking Home goes to '/', which redirects to '#/academy' (the RootGate redirect is expected). The top bar (Home, 'Sticker Shack' title, achievement/collection counts) has no overlap and no wrapping at mobile, tablet or desktop. The GameHeader shields on the three regression pages are unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor/cosmetic only: the inner HarpIcon is 32/40/56px because the container has p-1, while the GameHeader BackIcon is 36/44/60px. The outer box sizes match exactly, so the difference is not noticeable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: On a fresh localStorage, /sticker-book shows several overlays in a row: audio-unlock-overlay, then player-name-prompt (skip: player-name-skip), then tour-start-modal (close: tour-start-modal-close). A force-click in the centre of the audio overlay can fall through and open sticker-detail-modal, so click the overlay at its corner. '/' redirects to '/academy'.
